originality.rationale: The principal full-text comparison is arXiv:2611.19813v1. Its Theorem 6.3 and Corollary 6.4 assume a Poincaré duality pair and oriented manifolds over the coefficient field; for nonorientable manifolds over odd-characteristic fields that hypothesis demonstrably fails because top cohomology is zero. Their exact lemmas imply, but do not state, the new square-zero regime; the characteristic-two infinite-dimensional contrast for the same digraph and full nonorientable surface Hilbert functions are not asserted there. published-finding corpus queries with alternate terms returned only different graph/path homology or unrelated nonorientable complexes. A possible overlooked equivalent derivation remains a priority risk.

value.rationale: This is a structural coefficient-characteristic discontinuity for a fixed natural cyclic Hasse digraph: over odd characteristics its entire positive algebra is square-zero and finite, while in characteristic two it has nonnilpotent classes in arbitrarily high degrees. It closes an explicit orientability gap in the newest primary path-cohomology theorem for every closed nonorientable manifold, and supplies all crosscap-surface Hilbert series. Neither general framework nor a single low-degree finite experiment is the claimed contribution.
